meta.name: House on Haunted Hill
meta.description:
An eccentric millionaire throws a party for his wife in a haunted house offering each guest $10,000 if they can make it through the night. Only there seem to be schemes at work beyond what the ghosts have planned.

You can find out more about this movie on its IMDB page.

You can download an AVI of this movie here.

And this movie was featured on an episode of Frightmares the Series hosted on the Internet Archive here.
